competences.description: Attacks the enemy with razor-sharp claws and decreases the Defense for 2 turns with an 80% chance and inflicts Continuous Damage for 3 turns with an 80% chance.
Teams up with another ally to attack an enemy. The damage increases by 20% for each harmful effect on the enemy, and this effect also applies to the ally who attacks together.

effets.description: Brings one or more allies to attack at the same time.

competences.description: Attacks on the enemy's wounds to leave a Branding Effect for 2 turns. The damage increases by 50% for each harmful effect on the enemy.
